description.value: Ignite Pizzeria Express is the Gastown outpost of a Vancouver stone-fired pizza chain founded in 2017, and the only Express-format location in the group where pizza by the slice is sold. Hand-tossed pies are fired at 800° with a low-sodium dough rested for three days, and the menu spans carnivore, vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-friendly options. It sits on West Cordova Street in the heart of historic Gastown, making it a convenient refuelling stop for cyclists cutting through downtown Vancouver.
